title: Single-cell N4-acetylcytidine regulatory landscape identifies ARIH1 as a ferroptosis-suppressive oncogenic driver in lung adenocarcinoma.
authors: Tang, Min; Li, Guoqing; Wang, Lisi; Jian, Ying; Teng, Cai; Tu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦RNA乙酰化修饰与铁死亡调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: N4-acetylcytidine (ac4C) is an emerging post-transcriptional RNA modification implicated in cancer biology, yet its cellular distribution, prognostic value, and functional relevance in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to systematically define the ac4C-related regulatory landscape in LUAD and identify functionally and clinically relevant targets. METHODS: A single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset comprising 87,634 cells was reanalyzed to quantify ac4C-related gene (acRG) activity across major cellular compartments using AUCell scoring. Prognostic acRGs were identified through differential expression analysis and univariate Cox regression, followed by integrative machine-learning modeling using LASSO and random survival forest algorithms. The biological function of ARIH1 was examined through cell proliferation assays, ferroptosis-related biochemical measurements, and mechanistic analyses including cycloheximide chase, co-immunoprecipitation, and ubiquitination assays. RESULTS: Epithelial cells displayed the highest acRG activity within the LUAD tumor ecosystem. A prognostic acRG-based signature was established, identifying ARIH1 as a high-risk factor associated with unfavorable survival outcomes. ARIH1 knockdown significantly inhibited LUAD cell growth and tumorigenic potential. Mechanistically, ARIH1 interacted with NCOA4 and promoted its K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, thereby suppressing ferritinophagy and ferroptosis. ARIH1 loss resulted in iron accumulation, lipid peroxidation, glutathione depletion, and ferroptotic cell death. Additionally, ARIH1 depletion markedly enhanced cisplatin-induced ferroptosis. CONCLUSIONS: These findings map the single-cell ac4C regulatory architecture of LUAD and identify ARIH1 as a ferroptosis-suppressive E3 ubiquitin ligase, highlighting a potential therapeutic target to enhance ferroptosis-based and chemotherapy-based interventions.
abstract_zh: 背景：N4-乙酰胞苷（ac4C）是一种新兴的转录后RNA修饰，与癌症生物学相关，但其在肺腺癌（LUAD）中的细胞分布、预后价值及功能相关性仍未被充分表征。本研究旨在系统定义LUAD中ac4C相关调控景观，并识别功能性和临床相关的靶点。方法：重新分析了包含87,634个细胞的单细胞RNA测序数据集，使用AUCell评分量化主要细胞区室中ac4C相关基因（acRG）的活性。通过差异表达分析和单变量Cox回归识别预后相关acRG，随后使用LASSO和随机生存森林算法进行整合机器学习建模。通过细胞增殖实验、铁死亡相关生化测量以及包括环己酰亚胺追踪、共免疫沉淀和泛素化实验在内的机制分析，检测了ARIH1的生物学功能。结果：上皮细胞在LUAD肿瘤生态系统中显示出最高的acRG活性。建立了基于预后acRG的特征，将ARIH1识别为与不良生存结局相关的高风险因子。ARIH1敲低显著抑制LUAD细胞生长和致瘤潜力。机制上，ARIH1与NCOA4相互作用，促进其K48连接的泛素化和蛋白酶体降解，从而抑制铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡。ARIH1缺失导致铁积累、脂质过氧化、谷胱甘肽耗竭和铁死亡细胞死亡。此外，ARIH1缺失显著增强顺铂诱导的铁死亡。结论：这些发现描绘了LUAD的单细胞ac4C调控架构，并将ARIH1识别为一种铁死亡抑制性E3泛素连接酶，突显了增强基于铁死亡和化疗干预的潜在治疗靶点。
